definitions.explanation: A sensation of coldness felt in the body, often as a symptom of fever or illness. Can also refer to a shiver caused by fear or revulsion.

examples.english: I felt chills before the fever started.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{背筋|せすじ}→背筋：13931_sesuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寒気|さむけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: A chill ran down my spine when I heard that scary story.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
The same kanji {寒気|かんき} read as かんき means cold air or cold weather, which is a different word. This entry covers the さむけ reading only.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寒気|さむけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to feel a chill)
- {寒気|さむけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to sense chills)
- ⟦{背筋|せすじ}→背筋：13931_sesuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寒気|さむけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (a chill runs down one's spine)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悪寒|おかん}→悪寒：12670_okan⟧: chills (from illness) — more medical, specifically refers to fever-related chills
- ⟦{鳥肌|とりはだ}→鳥肌：08544_torihada⟧: goosebumps — the physical skin reaction from cold or fear
